svg.title: Abdul Hannan: the lab
svg.desc: A night desk scene. A CRT boots and types: Abdul Hannan. I build AI systems that prove their work. Then four systems load: the-brief, 3rd of 130, solo; demurrage-guard, AI reads, code proves; floodcut, 17.3 times P(opt), QAOA; leadlock, one lead, one owner.

g.text: I BUILD AI SYSTEMS THAT PROVE THEIR WORK.
